- There is no 'haloing' or color bleeding into the velvet pile.
- The texture of the embroidery appears slightly raised/distinct from the flat velvet, which is physically plausible.
- No structural collapse or impossible geometry is visible in the garment folds.

I find no evidence of artifacts. The severity rating of 0 (none) is appropriate.
